newsitem.title: USA: Coca-Cola Enterprises ends Nora talks.
newsitem.headline: Coca-Cola Enterprises ends Nora talks.

text.p: Coca-Cola Enterprises, the world's largest soft drink bottler, said Wednesday it ended negotiations to acquire Nora Beverages Inc. in a $117 million deal.

The company did not provide details of the failed negotiations but said it expected to continue distributing Nora's Naya products under existing distribution arrangements. Coca-Cola Enterprises is the largest distributor of Naya, handling more than 49 percent of worlwide unit cases sold.

Nora, based in Montreal, manufacturers spring water sold under the name Naya. Nora Beverages had revenue of about $63 million last year on sales of 14 million cases of the bottled water, the company said.
Atlanta-based Coca-Cola Enterprises had been in discussions with Nora since the signing of a letter of intent on July 17 with Nora's majority share owner.
